title: Alpha / charter
text:
Project Alpha (PRJ-001) is closed. PRJ-001 serves SITE-001. PRJ-001 uses TX-880. Northstar Power supplies TX-880.

Scope: deliver a resilient microgrid for municipal facilities. The sponsor requires documented acceptance and a handover package. The project manager coordinates procurement, safety review, construction and commissioning.

Gate reviews require current risks, verified technical assumptions and explicit decision owners.

title: Alpha / incident
text:
Incident INC-001 on Project Alpha: transformer winding insulation failed factory testing. INC-001 affected TX-880. The commissioning milestone slipped by 6 weeks. Containment: quarantine the affected unit pending vendor review.

The site team recorded photographs, instrument readings and the inspection checklist. This record describes a fictional event; it is not an equipment operating procedure.

edges.evidence: The commissioning milestone slipped by 6 weeks.

title: Alpha / risk
text: Risk RISK-001 for Project Alpha: repeat TX-880 acceptance failure could delay energization. Owner: procurement lead. RISK-001 threatens MS-001. Trigger: missing factory test evidence ten business days before shipment. Response: require witnessed factory acceptance before shipment.

edges.evidence: repeat TX-880 acceptance failure could delay energization.

title: Alpha / change
text: Change CR-001 on Project Alpha revises acceptance requirement REQ-001. CR-001 modifies REQ-001. Approved scope: require witnessed factory acceptance before shipment. CR-001 addresses INC-001. Approval owner: engineering review board. Budget delta: 15000 fictional USD.

title: Alpha / lesson
text: Lesson LL-001 from Project Alpha: require witnessed factory acceptance before shipment. LL-001 follows INC-001. LL-001 applies to TX-880. Reuse this lesson at the procurement gate of future projects before purchase-order release.

title: Alpha / decision
text: Decision DEC-001 moved MS-001 by 6 weeks because transformer winding insulation failed factory testing. DEC-001 responds to INC-001. The board accepted the schedule change only after reviewing the incident and change CR-001.

edges.evidence: Decision DEC-001 moved MS-001 by 6 weeks because transformer winding insulation failed factory testing.

title: Alpha / status
text: Current Project Alpha status: commissioning is delayed 6 weeks. The approved recovery plan tracks CR-001, RISK-001 and MS-001. Technical cause: transformer winding insulation failed factory testing. Next action: require witnessed factory acceptance before shipment.

title: Alpha / status old
text: Preliminary Project Alpha forecast: commissioning is on time. The vendor expects to ship next month. This forecast predates INC-001 and has been superseded by the current status report.

title: Alpha / rfi
text: RFI for Project Alpha: please confirm the test evidence required for TX-880. Engineering references change CR-001. The supplier must return signed acceptance records with the shipping release.

title: Alpha / minutes
text: Project Alpha coordination meeting: the team reviewed civil works and cable routing. Procurement will chase the TX-880 documentation. No new engineering acceptance decision was authorized in this meeting.

title: Alpha / vendor
text: Northstar Power correspondence for Project Alpha: replacement materials are reserved. Factory test witnessing remains subject to review under CR-001. The commercial contact cannot waive engineering requirements.
